locator: I.13 [15]: That which moves as an instrumental cause cannot move unless there be a principal moving cause
interpretation: First premise of the third proof against an infinite series of movers: an instrumental mover cannot move unless there is a principal mover. Read with the conclusion that in an infinite series of moved movers, all instrumental, nothing would be moved. Basis: the English translation named in the passage manifest; a candidate for upgrade once a pinned Latin witness exists, and never a ground for overriding a reading of the Leonine/SCTA Latin.
